name: Doctor Doom, King of Latveria
oracle_text:
Whenever you discard one or more land cards, each opponent loses 2 life.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target Villain you control gains menace until end of turn. It connives. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you discard one or more land cards, each opponent loses 2 life.

needs.what: a `batched` ('whenever you discard one or more <filter> cards') discard trigger: the `discard` event carrying the `state.event_batch` of its simultaneous discard group so a trigger with `batched: true` and filter `types: [Land]` fires once per discard event that included at least one matching card, not once per card
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `discard` trigger event exists and its filter can ask the discarded card's type, but it fires once per card discarded; `batched` is only accepted on BATCHED_EVENTS (permanent_enters, leaves_graveyard, token_created, attacks_unblocked, dealt_damage), so discarding two lands at once (e.g. to a connive or a hand-size discard) would drain 4 instead of 2
